name: int_repr
description: ATen schema: aten::int_repr(Tensor self) -> Tensor. Semantics: int_repr returns the raw integer codes stored by an affine-quantized tensor (quint8 -> uint8, qint8 -> int8, qint32 -> int32) with the same shape as the input; the scale/zero-point metadata does not enter the result, so comparisons are exact (rtol=0, atol=0) and no autograd history is carried. Per-tensor quantization is covered unconditionally; per-channel (torch.per_channel_affine) coverage exists only where the backend declares float64 and int64 support, so it is capability-gated. Rank-0 and zero-sized quantized inputs are valid, and transpose / offset slice / strided slice / zero-stride expand / channels_last views read exactly like a compact clone. Non-quantized dtypes are asserted to fail with RuntimeError only on the CUDA/NVIDIA snapshot (the negative rows are built when vendor_name is "nvidia"); a non-tensor argument fails with RuntimeError/TypeError. Broadcasting and backward do not apply to this operator. The independent buffer overload is described by int_repr_out.
